tasks.name: Implement Qwen2.5 Model Strategy with GPU Offloading
tasks.description: Update the LLM engine to support the optimal Qwen2.5 model strategy: 3B as default (balanced intelligence), 1.5B for ultra-light CPU, and 7B with optional GPU layer offloading. Add GPU detection, layer offloading configuration, and dynamic model selection based on hardware capabilities.
tasks.notes: Focus on K-quantization (q4_K_M) for optimal CPU performance. Ensure backward compatibility with existing configurations.

relatedFiles.description: Implement GPU detection and layer offloading

tasks.implementationGuide:
1. Update LLMConfig to include model_size, enable_gpu_offload, and gpu_layers fields
2. Add GPU detection logic using CUDA/OpenCL availability
3. Implement model path mapping for 1.5B/3B/7B variants
4. Add n_gpu_layers parameter to llama.cpp initialization
5. Create model validation and fallback mechanisms
6. Update configuration files and documentation
tasks.verificationCriteria:
1. All three model sizes (1.5B, 3B, 7B) can be loaded and used
2. GPU layer offloading works when GPU is available
3. Automatic fallback to CPU-only when GPU unavailable
4. Model switching works without restarting the application
5. Performance benchmarks show expected improvements with GPU offloading
tasks.analysisResult: Complete PebbleMind project for open source release with focus on excellent text-to-text chat experience. Priority is implementing the optimal Qwen2.5 model strategy with K-quantization (q4_K_M) and optional GPU layer offloading. Need to finalize the desktop application, optimize the core chat experience, and prepare for open source release with comprehensive documentation and testing.
tasks.summary: Successfully implemented Qwen2.5 Model Strategy with GPU Offloading. Updated LLMConfig to support model_size, enable_gpu_offload, and gpu_layers fields. Added GPU detection logic for CUDA/OpenCL/Metal. Implemented model path mapping for 1.5B/3B/7B variants with automatic path resolution. Added n_gpu_layers parameter to llama.cpp initialization with auto-detection based on model size. Created model validation and fallback mechanisms. Updated configuration files to use 3B as default. Enhanced CLI with model switching command and improved status display. Updated model download script to include all three model sizes. Created comprehensive demo script showing all features. All verification criteria met: three model sizes supported, GPU offloading works when available, automatic fallback to CPU-only, model switching without restart, and performance improvements documented.
